subject: math.QA
name: Kaplansky’s sixth conjecture
statement: If H is a finite-dimensional semisimple Hopf algebra over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, must dim(V) divide dim(H) for every simple H-module V?
importance: Extends a central divisibility theorem of finite-group representation theory to quantum symmetry.
status_note: Known for many classes of semisimple Hopf algebras; the general case remains open.

references.title: Dai and Dong, On Kaplansky’s sixth conjecture

subject: math.QA
name: Bijectivity of antipodes for Noetherian Hopf algebras
statement: Must the antipode of every Hopf algebra over a field that is both left and right Noetherian be bijective?
importance: Would establish a basic structural symmetry of Noetherian quantum groups.
status_note: Injectivity and several bijectivity cases are known; in particular residual finite dimensionality gives bijectivity. That extra hypothesis is not assumed here.

references.title: Skryabin, Flatness of Noetherian Hopf algebras over coideal subalgebras

subject: math.QA
name: Faithful flatness over Noetherian Hopf subalgebras
statement: If H is a left and right Noetherian Hopf algebra over a field and K ⊆ H is a left and right Noetherian Hopf subalgebra, must H be faithfully flat as both a left and a right K-module?
importance: Would make quotient and descent constructions for Noetherian quantum groups behave uniformly.
status_note: Known with additional hypotheses such as residual finite dimensionality; those hypotheses are not part of this question.

references.title: Skryabin, Flatness of Noetherian Hopf algebras over coideal subalgebras

subject: math.QA
name: Finite-dimensional Nichols algebras over nonabelian finite groups
statement: For finite nonabelian groups G and finite-dimensional Yetter–Drinfeld modules V over C[G], which pairs (G,V) have a finite-dimensional Nichols algebra B(V)?
importance: This classification controls the building blocks of finite-dimensional pointed quantum groups.
status_note: Diagonal-type Nichols algebras and many families are classified; a classification across nonabelian finite groups is not known.

subject: math.QA
name: Property F conjecture
statement: For every weakly integral braided fusion category over C, do all braid-group actions on Hom(Y,X^{⊗n}) arising from its braiding have finite image?
importance: Predicts when quantum braid operations generate finite rather than dense families of transformations.
status_note: Proved for many explicit categories and weakly group-theoretical braided categories; the full weakly integral class remains open.

references.title: Naidu and Rowell, A finiteness property for braided fusion categories
Li and Ruan, Generalized property F for weakly group-theoretical modular fusion categories

subject: math.QA
name: Unitary modular category realization by vertex operator algebras
statement: Does every unitary modular tensor category occur, up to braided equivalence, as the representation category of a unitary rational C_2-cofinite vertex operator algebra of CFT type?
importance: Would connect abstract quantum algebraic data to chiral conformal field theory constructions.
status_note: Many examples are known, but there is no realization theorem for every unitary modular category.

references.title: Wang and Wang, In and around Abelian anyon models

subject: math.QA
name: Weakly integral fusion categories are weakly group-theoretical
statement: Is every fusion category over C with integer Frobenius–Perron dimension Morita equivalent to a category obtained from Vec by successive finite-group extensions?
importance: Would explain weakly integral quantum symmetries in terms of finite-group constructions.
status_note: This asks for weakly group-theoretical structure, not the stronger and false claim that every such category is group-theoretical.

references.title: Etingof, Nikshych and Ostrik, Weakly group-theoretical and solvable fusion categories

subject: math.QA
name: Deligne–Drinfeld freeness conjecture
statement: Is the graded Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie algebra grt_1 over Q the degree-completion of a free Lie algebra on one generator in each odd degree 3,5,7,...?
importance: Would determine the universal algebra governing associators and deformation quantization symmetries.
status_note: A free motivic Lie subalgebra is known; the conjecture requires that no further generators or relations occur in grt_1.

references.title: Naef and Willwacher, Numerical computation of linearized KV and the Deligne–Drinfeld and Broadhurst–Kreimer conjectures

subject: math.QA
name: Grothendieck–Teichmüller and double-shuffle equality
statement: Is grt_1 equal to the normalized regularized double-shuffle Lie algebra dmr_0 over Q under their natural inclusion in the completed free Lie algebra on two generators?
importance: Asks whether associator relations and multiple-zeta double-shuffle relations encode the same infinitesimal quantum symmetry.
status_note: The inclusion grt_1 ⊆ dmr_0 is established; equality is stronger and remains open.

references.title: Furusho, Double shuffle relation for associators
Naef and Willwacher, Numerical computation of linearized KV and the Deligne–Drinfeld and Broadhurst–Kreimer conjectures

subject: math.QA
name: Colored Jones volume conjecture
statement: For every hyperbolic knot K, with J_N normalized to equal one on the unknot, does lim_{N→infinity} (2π/N) log|J_N(K;exp(2πi/N))| equal the hyperbolic volume of S^3 minus K?
importance: Would recover geometric volume from quantum-group knot invariants in a semiclassical limit.
status_note: Proved for some knots and related families; the statement for every hyperbolic knot remains open.
